findings.summary: No open Input regression for a plain standalone input; hits were Combobox, Select, OTP, NumberField, Toolbar.Input and enhancement #5991 (adornments), none apply to this usage
aria-invalid ring hides keyboard focus on controls; affects Radix and Base styles equally (same classes), so not a migration difference

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog searches were not run; only GitHub and base-ui.com docs

notes: Registry files differ only by wrapping Base UI's Input primitive. Compared 1280x900 dark: size, position, colours, opacity, cursor, pointer-events and focus ring (click then type) identical for all six variants; zoomed screenshots identical. DOM adds an auto-generated id on every input and data-disabled on the disabled one; nothing in src selects on them. No consumer changes needed. 390x844 not checked: resize_window did not change the viewport width (screenshots stayed 1280 wide). Keyboard Tab/Shift+Tab not exercised separately. Boilerplate pages and input-group consumers were not visually compared, only built and checked by check:gallery.
